description: This file contains test utilities for nghttp2 within the HTTP/2 adapter namespace, including a TestDataSource class and various matchers for nghttp2 frame types.

classes.name: TestDataSource
classes.description: A simple class that can be adapted to act as a nghttp2_data_source, providing data for HTTP/2 frames.

methods.name: ReadNext
methods.description: Reads the next chunk of data up to a specified size.

methods.name: SelectPayloadLength
methods.description: Selects the payload length to send, up to a maximum.

methods.name: MakeDataProvider
methods.description: Creates an nghttp2_data_provider for the data source.
